name: muzo
description: Muzo - a native desktop music player with libraries, playlists and recursive folder sync.

scripts.lint: yarn workspace @muzo/desktop-rust native:lint && yarn workspace @muzo/distribution lint && yarn workspace @muzo/site lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @muzo/desktop-rust native:typecheck && yarn workspace @muzo/distribution typecheck && yarn workspace @muzo/site typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspace @muzo/desktop-rust native:test && yarn workspace @muzo/distribution test && yarn workspace @muzo/site test
scripts.clean: yarn workspace @muzo/desktop-rust clean && yarn workspace @muzo/distribution clean && yarn workspace @muzo/site clean && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('node_modules', { recursive: true, force: true })"
